Mali.title: Military Command: Lines move after April 25
Mali.summary: The appointments of May 29, 2026 reorganize several sensitive positions in the Malian military chain. They come after an offensive that changed Bamako's security priorities. This change is not limited to a circulation of names in the military apparatus .

Mali.title: San: Army fends off attack despite casualties
Mali.summary: An attack was perpetrated Sunday, August 9 against the grip of the 23rd San Infantry Regiment. The General Staff of the Armed Forces claims to have regained control of the camp after fighting that resulted in casualties in the military ranks and among the attackers According to the statement issued Monday, August 10, the attack began around 5:30 a.m. and mobilized heavy machine guns, kamikaze drones, charge-dropping drones as well as two armored vehicles.

Mali.title: Under FAMa fire: Several terrorist logistics bases destroyed in Tessalit, Nampala and Sofara
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their permanent operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Wednesday, September 30, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, in the immediate outskirts of Tessalit, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war and logistics equipment.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa destroy a terrorist base with armed vehicles south of Koutiala
Mali.summary: In a statement, the General Staff of the Armed Forces said that the operations to secure the territory, carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, are continuing. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted a new targeted strike on Saturday, October 3, 2026 On Saturday, October 3, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, several points of entrenchment of armed terrorist groups.

Mali.title: Koutiala: Neutralization of terrorist shelters and armed vehicles by FAMa
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their permanent operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Saturday, October 3, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war materials including many armed vehicles.

Mali.title: Kidal: six wounded evacuated to Gao, the Fla speaks of released soldiers
Mali.summary: AT this TIME The International Committee of the Red Cross specifies that it organized this evacuation after obtaining security guarantees from all parties to the conflict. Its press release does not give the identity of the persons transferred and does not specify their status. This discretion corresponds to his mandate as a neutral intermediary and the confidential nature of his dialogue with the belligerents On the same day, the Azawad Liberation Front announced that it had entrusted six wounded Malian soldiers, captured in previous clashes, to the ICRC.

Mali.title: Targeted financial sanctions: Bamako expands its security pressure tool
Mali.summary: AT THIS TIME The text provides for the freezing of the property and economic resources of the persons concerned for six renewable months. It is based on national texts relating to the fight against money laundering, the financing of terrorism and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction . The grievances are formulated identically for the twelve names: alleged support for JNIM and the Azawad Liberation Front, promotion or apology of terrorism, criminal association and facilitation of terrorist acts.

Mali.title: BAMEX 2025: A strategic strengthening of military cooperation in Mali
Mali.summary: This exhibition, which takes place in two phases, began with an exhibition at the Bamako Exhibition Park and continues with practical demonstrations at the Boubacar Sada Sy Center in Koulikoro. It offers a unique opportunity to discover state-of-the-art equipment, presented by more than 30 international companies, mainly Turkish, but also Russian and Chinese .

Mali.title: FAMa: positions of armed groups targeted in Abéïbara and near Sévaré
Mali.summary: AT THIS MOMENT The Malian army continues its air operations against the armed groups active in the country. In a statement issued Wednesday, August 26, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported a series of strikes in the north and center of Mali, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the military hierarchy, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible, on Monday, August 24, to locate several regroupment points of armed terrorist groups in Abéïbara, in the Kidal region.

Mali.title: 65th anniversary of the Malian Army: the nation pays tribute to its forces
Mali.summary: Mali commemorated this Tuesday the 65th anniversary of the creation of its national army, on the occasion of an official ceremony presided over by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: In Mali, from the Wagner Group to Africa Corps, the continuity of impunity?
Mali.summary: The transfer of Wagner's mercenaries to the military of Africa Corps, two Russian organizations, did not put an end to the abuses against civilians.

Mali.title: Senou: A dangerous network of inoperable motorcycle robbers
Mali.summary: FIGHT AGAINST DELINQUENCY and CRIME: As part of the strengthening of security, the Senou Police Station, headed by Chief Police Commissioner Cheickna SOW, arrested three (03) individuals suspected of being members of a criminal network on 19 September 2026 The operation, carried out by the Research Brigade, follows the denunciation of several cases of motorcycle theft in the peripheral districts of Bamako and the surrounding localities, sometimes followed by robberies.

Mali.title: Mali: Evidence of War Crimes
Mali.summary: Members of Mali’s armed forces working together with personnel from the Wagner Group committed war crimes, including the murder and torture of civilians, during joint operations between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

Mali.title: Mali: Report Accuses Army and Wagner of War Crimes
Mali.summary: - Civilians killed in joint military operations - Civilians tortured to death in detention; others beaten, simulated drowning and electrocuted - Fulani, Arabs and Tuaregs targeted Members of the Malian armed forces acting with members of the Wagner group committed war crimes, including killings and torture of civilians during operations carried out between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

Mali.title: ‘No one is spared’: War crimes committed by the Malian army and foreign allied forces along the Mauritanian border
Mali: "No One is Spared" War Crimes Committed by the Malian Army and Foreign Allied Forces along the Mauritanian Border
Crash of the Air Algérie flight AH5017 in Mali, the judgment expected in Paris
Mali.summary: Twelve years after the crash of Air Algérie flight AH5017, judgment is expected on Monday, September 28, 2026 in Paris. The aircraft, operated by the Spanish company Swiftair and chartered by Air Algérie, crashed on 24 July 2014 near Gossi, in the Timbuktu region. All 116 people on board, including a Malian, had perished.

Burkina Faso.title: ECOWAS – ESA: Cooperating against terrorism
Burkina Faso.summary: Meeting on 19 July 2026 in Lungi, Sierra Leone, ECOWAS decided to deepen the dialogue with the Alliance of Sahel States with a view to a security cooperation mechanism. An orientation to reconnect regional efforts against a cross-border threat. On the ground, armed groups cross borders and use regional networks to source weapons, motorcycles, fuel or drones .

Burkina Faso.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
Burkina Faso.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

Burkina Faso.title: 29 September 2026 - 14:21 Ouagadougou: a cannabis trafficking network dismantled, 86 kg seized
Burkina Faso.summary: The Anti-Drug Unit of the Judicial Police Directorate has put an end to the activities of a cannabis trafficking and sales network in Ouagadougou. This structured group also engaged in the sale of adulterated beverages, contraband cigarettes and psychotropic products. According to the police, the goods were transported from a neighboring country, by public or personal transport vehicles .

Burkina Faso.title: BURKINA FASO: 81st UN General Assembly In full the Declaration of Burkina Faso on behalf of the Confederation of Sahel States, delivered by Comrade Karamoko Jean Marie Traore, Minister of Foreign Affairs
Burkina Faso.summary: New York, September 28, 2026 Mr. President, Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen, I have the great honor to carry, from this rostrum, the voice of Their Excellencies Comrade Captain Ibrahim TRAORÉ, President of Faso, Head of State and President of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES); Army General Assimi GOITA President of the Transition, Head of State of the Republic of Mali and Army General Abdourahamane TIANI, President of the Republic of Niger, Head of State.

Niger.title: Niger: the mutiny that targeted the heart of power
Niger.summary: RIGHT NOW The events of August 29th go far beyond a barracks protest. They establish an armed mutiny directed against several strategic sites, but the public elements do not yet allow to reconstitute an organized project of seizure of power Three days after the shots that shook Niamey, the Nigerien authorities are once again in control of Air Base 101, Diori-Hamani International Airport, the presidential palace and the other targeted sites.

Niger.title: Agadez: the Regional Security Council examines the security situation and recommends strengthening the existing system
Niger.summary: The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired, on Wednesday, March 11, 2026, the regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS), held in the usual meeting room in the Governorate of Agadez . This meeting allowed the members of this forum to examine the security situation in the region and identify the measures necessary to strengthen the protection of populations and their property.

Niger.title: Agadez: more than 50 kg of cocaine and other narcotics seized in Arlit
Niger.summary: The National Gendarmerie intercepted more than 50 kilograms of cocaine as well as other narcotic products during a security operation conducted in the department of Arlit. The market value of the seized drug is estimated at more than two billion CFA francs. The products were handed over to the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez .

Niger.title: Agadez: Ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS)
Niger.summary: Agadez, Sept. 24 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS). Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region .

Niger.title: Pregabalin trafficking in Agadez: Two individuals arrested, 6,900 capsules seized by OCRTIS
Niger.summary: On 22 September 2026, the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez arrested two individuals suspected of being involved in pregabalin trafficking. The operation resulted in the seizure of 6,900 capsules of this highly risky substance, discovered in the hands of the first suspect and at the home of the second .
